knownLimitations: Qualification source data were synthetic. An attestor signature proves control of the nominated wallet, not employee, supervisor or payroll identity, actual attendance, or document truth. The contract does not pay wages. No employment identity oracle is connected. Studionet RPC can temporarily rate-limit registry reads; the 2026-10-18 rate-limit response and 2026-10-19 successful production retry are both preserved. Case storage is append-only and unbounded over time.
name: ShiftFair
short: Resolve shift and overtime eligibility from frozen work rules and attested evidence, with capped deterministic minute calculations.
problem: Shift decisions combine written work rules, supervisor authorization, attendance evidence and capped overtime arithmetic.
solution: ShiftFair supports participation, frozen work rules, attendance evidence, a distinct attestor, semantic adjudication, two-party challenges, second-round deliberation, and finalization. The production app reads a paged canonical case registry and supports wallet-validated actions with transaction receipt and canonical state reconciliation. Requested, provisional and final minutes are capped by contract rules.
outcomes: Leader and validators independently classify supervisor_authorized, attendance_matches_shift and evidence_sufficient in gl.vm.run_nondet_unsafe. The strict vector is checked; contract arithmetic caps policy/requested minutes and derives a provisional result. Challenges enter round two; disagreement cannot silently approve.
productionQualification: V4.0.0 production deployment READY; signed-browser wallet recovery and canonical registry qualification PASS on 2026-10-19 after the RPC quota reset. The earlier 500-requests/hour response is preserved. Portal dossier prepared, not submitted.
